title: oldenlandia galioides
intro: Oldenlandia galioides, commonly known as Galium, is a plant species belonging to the Rubiaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues. The health benefits of Oldenlandia galioides include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions in treating fever and other conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
